input: # Documents as alchemy/render.alc writes them, and the trees they read
# back as. Atom requires an id, a title and an updated of a feed and of
# each entry, and the render writes one the tree lacks by the conventions
# the loss list in tabnas.plugin.json states: the id
# tag:tabnas.dev,2026:feed-render, an entry's with a slash and its
# position after it, an empty title of type text, and the updated
# 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z. Every runtime reads them back as written.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom">
  <title type="text">News</title>
  <id>tag:tabnas.dev,2026:feed-render</id>
  <updated>1970-01-01T00:00:00Z</updated>
  <entry>
    <summary type="html">First</summary>
    <id>tag:tabnas.dev,2026:feed-render/0</id>
    <title type="text"></title>
    <updated>1970-01-01T00:00:00Z</updated>
  </entry>
  <entry>
    <title type="text">Second</title>
    <id>http://example.org/2</id>
    <link href="http://example.org/2" rel="alternate"/>
    <updated>1970-01-01T00:00:00Z</updated>
  </entry>
</feed>
